UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = DATEADD(dd,-1,@DATETOPROCESS)
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB_GROUP_SRC B ON 
COALESCE(A.CUST_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CUST_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CIF_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIF_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
